item.question: In what way does consistent time travel improve an RL agent's performance compared to using naive sequential historical data?
item.answer: Consistent time travel enhances an RL agent's performance by aligning historical states with real-time actions, providing a more accurate representation of system dynamics. This method results in higher gains for the agent compared to using naive sequential historical data that may not reflect true interactions.
